profile.name: 通量可调超导量子比特
profile.description: 一种工作于低温量子测量系统中的超导量子比特，可通过微波信号进行驱动与读出，并通过磁通偏置调谐到甜点或反甜点附近。该器件常用于连续波谱测、时域相干实验、磁通扫描、自动表征以及量子读出链优化。
profile.description_en: A superconducting qubit used in low-temperature quantum measurement systems. It is controlled and read out with microwave signals and can be tuned with magnetic flux bias near sweet spots or anti-sweet spots. It is commonly used for continuous-wave spectroscopy, time-domain coherence experiments, flux tuning, automated characterization, and optimization of the qubit readout chain.

registry.description: HAL Shim SQ是由QuTech生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, get int avg det等操作。
